description:
pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs:263-269 — CodeSigningProfile sets:
  `p.max_validity_secs = Some(1185 * 86_400);`

The doc comment says:
'CS BR §6.3.2: certificates issued before 2026-03-01 may be valid for up to 39 months; ... Certificates issued on or after 2026-03-01 are limited to 460 days (CS BR v3.8). This profile implements the pre-2026-03-01 rule (1185 days).'

As of today (2026-05-07), the post-2026-03-01 rule (460 days) is now in effect. The profile is actively wrong for new certificates issued after 2026-03-01.

Unlike WebPkiProfile (which defers to pkix-lint ValidityMaxLint for phased enforcement), CodeSigningProfile hardcodes 1185 days via max_validity_secs. This is a policy enforcement hole: the profile claims to enforce CS BR but does not enforce the 460-day cap for certs issued after 2026-03-01.

Suggested fix: Either implement a SC-081-style phased cap in pkix-profiles, or update the profile to use 460 days (breaking change for certs issued between 2024 and 2026-03-01). At minimum, add a doc comment warning that the profile is stale after 2026-03-01.

P2 — the profile actively misrepresents current CS BR requirements.
title: pkix-profiles CodeSigningProfile uses pre-2026-03-01 rule; post-2026 460-day cap not enforced
